$comment: JEV harness configuration. Copy to harness/config.json and edit. The MCP server reads `provider`, `memory`, and `packs`; the `env` block documents environment variables (put those in .env.local — secrets never belong in this file).

env.$comment: Reference for the environment. Read from the process env, not from this JSON.
env.ENGRAM_HTTP_TOKEN: <optional; only if your Engram requires a token>

memory.$comment: Memory is advisory context for the in-repo ContextPrimer. engram | neon | none.

defaults.$comment: Adoption is shadow-first (plan §7): run packs, log decisions, change nothing until the ledger proves value. Thresholds below are UNCALIBRATED starting points.

packs.$comment: Per-pack enable flag and threshold override. Omit a pack to use its built-in default.
